WITH object_address AS (
  SELECT io.Insurable_Object_Identifier, la.Line_1_Address
  FROM acme_insurance.main.insurable_object AS io
  JOIN acme_insurance.main.geographic_location AS gl
    ON gl.Geographic_Location_Identifier = io.Geographic_Location_Identifier
  JOIN acme_insurance.main.location_address AS la
    ON la.Location_Address_Identifier = gl.Location_Address_Identifier
),
losses AS (
  SELECT oa.Line_1_Address,
         SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS incurred_losses
  FROM acme_insurance.main.claim AS c
  JOIN object_address AS oa
    ON oa.Insurable_Object_Identifier = c.Insurable_Object_Identifier
  JOIN acme_insurance.main.claim_amount AS ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM acme_insurance.main.loss_payment AS lp WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
     OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM acme_insurance.main.loss_reserve AS lr WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
  GROUP BY oa.Line_1_Address
),
prem AS (
  SELECT oa.Line_1_Address,
         SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS written_premium
  FROM object_address AS oa
  JOIN acme_insurance.main.policy_coverage_detail AS pcd
    ON pcd.Insurable_Object_Identifier = oa.Insurable_Object_Identifier
  JOIN acme_insurance.main.policy_amount AS pa
    ON pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
   AND pa.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
  JOIN acme_insurance.main.premium AS pr
    ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY oa.Line_1_Address
)
SELECT l.Line_1_Address,
       l.incurred_losses,
       p.written_premium,
       l.incurred_losses * 1.0 / NULLIF(p.written_premium, 0) AS loss_ratio
FROM losses AS l
LEFT JOIN prem AS p
  ON p.Line_1_Address = l.Line_1_Address
ORDER BY loss_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 500
